tokens.name: sea
tokens.usage: Background of the whole app: the sea the panels rest on.

tokens.name: sea-deep
tokens.usage: Water on the map and on stages with a map. Never behind small text.

tokens.name: land
tokens.usage: Panels, forms and lists: solid ground.

tokens.name: land-soft
tokens.usage: Cells inside a panel, highlighted rows, summary boxes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text on land, land-soft, sea and nation. Surface for decisions and scoreboards.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on land (6.2:1) and sea (5.1:1).

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Metadata on land only (4.5:1). Never on sea.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel borders and separators. Decorative; does not delimit controls.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Border of fields and secondary buttons (3.5:1 on land).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and light buttons on ink.

tokens.name: nation
tokens.usage: The player's country color (Argentina). Tints the bar, their territory and their surfaces. Text on top: on-nation.

tokens.name: nation-deep
tokens.usage: Large figures of the player's own country on land (24 px or larger only).

tokens.name: nation-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the player's country chips and notices.

tokens.name: nation-on-ink
tokens.usage: The player's country figures on ink (8.8:1).

tokens.name: war
tokens.usage: Combat action and live state. Only one war button per screen. Text on top: on-ink (5.2:1).

tokens.name: war-text
tokens.usage: Alert or defeat text on land and war-tint.

tokens.name: war-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Live chips and error notes.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Gains and confirmations: always with a + sign or an icon, never color alone.

tokens.name: positive-tint
tokens.usage: Background of success notes and chips.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Resources running out. Only large figures or icons on land.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Links and the focus ring (6.2:1 on land).

tokens.name: energy
tokens.usage: The player's energy: bolt and bar. Never as text.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Global currency. Always with its coin icon.

tokens.name: gold-border
tokens.usage: Inner ring of the Gold icon.

tokens.name: country-arg
tokens.usage: Argentina on maps, silhouettes and legends.

tokens.name: country-inactive
tokens.usage: Countries not in play on the map: gray, no interaction.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Headline of the landing stage. Width 122 %.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Title inside a panel or a row.

styles.name: score-xl
styles.usage: Damage percentage on the stage. Width 124 %, tabular figures.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Elige un país y entra a la batalla en dos minutos.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tu jornada produce trigo para Molinos del Litoral.

styles.name: support
styles.usage: Hints and metadata. The minimum size for interface text.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Only inside status chips, always paired with an icon or a clear word.

styles.name: place-xl
styles.usage: Country or region that leads a screen.

styles.name: place
styles.usage: Place names in panels, map labels and scoreboards.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between icon and text inside a chip.

tokens.name: panel-border
tokens.usage: The only border of a panel. Panels have no shadow.

tokens.name: floating
tokens.usage: Only what floats over the map: region panel, zoom controls.

tokens.name: document
tokens.usage: The citizenship document and the phone view on the landing.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: White halo outside the focus ring, so it shows on ink and on nation.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything that can be touched or focused.

tokens.name: touch-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button of a screen and the Hit button.
